scenes.headline: How a small adapter turns a generator into an editor
scenes.sub: Restore an archive clip, relight a pasted product
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Strudel! Two new adapters turn big generators into editors: one restores old film, one relights a pasted product.

scenes.text: Put a clean reference into the generator's own sequence, and a low-rank diff teaches it what to copy and what to redraw.
scenes.mark: what to copy and what to redraw
scenes.say: The idea: put a clean reference inside the generator's own sequence. A small weight change teaches it what to copy, and what to redraw.

parts.note: two thin matrices of rank r
parts.say: Add two thin matrices. At rank one twenty eight, that is about six percent of a big projection.

parts.note: equal to one in both files
parts.say: Both files set this scale to one.

steps.say: The archive clip becomes tokens, kept clean, at noise level zero.
The target starts as noise on the same position grid. Both run through the transformer as one sequence.
Each target token can attend to its matching reference token. Training scores only the target.

steps.note: the adapter learns what to copy
steps.say: The adapter learns to copy layout and motion, and to override grain, blur and colour.

scenes.title: How the restore adapter was trained

items.say: Take a clean high definition clip.
Tint it, blur it, shrink it, compress it, scratch it.
The damaged clip is the reference; the clean one is the answer.
A hundred and fifty one pairs.

scenes.credit: Lightricks Restore model card, gallery clip
scenes.title: A 1954 family meal

steps.say: And the result. The wall, the sweater and every strand of hair are the model's guess.

scenes.label: the pixels in the output, against a 640 x 480 scan
scenes.note: two of three colour channels have no source
scenes.say: Twenty times the pixels of the scan, two colour channels with no source. A reconstruction, not a record.

steps.say: The image editor does the same. Here a toy is pasted in, border and all.
Relit, the neon reaches the fur and a shadow appears. But the product is redrawn too.

scenes.text: A reference in the sequence teaches a mapping; it cannot add what the reference never held.
scenes.mark: cannot add what the reference never held
scenes.say: The reference teaches a mapping. It cannot add what it never held.

The reference rides in the sequence
Restored detail is drawn, not recovered
scenes.say: A low-rank diff, a reference in the sequence, and detail drawn, not recovered.
